definitions.explanation: A room in a hospital where patients stay during their admission. Also used more broadly for any room where a sick person rests.

examples.japanese: {病室|びょうしつ}は{何号室|なんごうしつ}ですか。
examples.english: What room number is the patient's room?

examples.japanese: {病室|びょうしつ}に{花|はな}を{持|も}っていった。
examples.english: I brought flowers to the hospital room.

examples.japanese: {個室|こしつ}の{病室|びょうしつ}は{料金|りょうきん}が{高|たか}いが、ゆっくり{休|やす}める。
examples.english: A private hospital room is expensive, but you can rest peacefully.

notes:
A standard compound: {病|びょう} (illness) + {室|しつ} (room). Very common in hospital-related contexts.

ROOM TYPES:
- {個室|こしつ}: private room (single occupancy)
- {大部屋|おおべや}: shared ward (multiple beds)
- {二人部屋|ふたりべや}: double room
- {四人部屋|よにんべや}: four-bed room

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病室|びょうしつ}を{訪|たず}ねる: to visit a hospital room
- {病室|びょうしつ}に{入|はい}る: to enter the hospital room
- {病室|びょうしつ}で{過|す}ごす: to spend time in a hospital room
- {病室|びょうしつ}の{窓|まど}: the hospital room window

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {病棟|びょうとう}: hospital ward — the building or floor containing multiple rooms
- {診察室|しんさつしつ}: examination room — where doctors see patients for consultations
